column4: profile lookup is access to resource profile and returning it is an emit to html; the caller check is the monitor's check

the language has no equality, subtraction or comparison operator to compare the password with the credential, and no way to return a result that depends on a secret without that result counting as a leak
formatted response approximated by an integer stored in the buffer cell; error path selected by free integer flag err; one free after the if covers both paths
no arrays: the record block is one heap cell; the fixed maximum is a counted loop of 32 and flag more stands for slot index below the requested count
no parameter binding: the bound id is approximated by san ( input ) inside a quoted literal; spaces in SQL replaced by underscores
no path resolution or string comparison: the containment check/rejection is approximated by san ( input ) before the fs sink
request method is a literal; stripping control characters is approximated by san ( input ) for the log sink
HTML escaping is san ( input ) inside literal markup
upstream call is access upstream; token is held in a secret cell and never placed in any public cell or emitted
role flag is a free integer variable; session key is held in a secret cell and never used in a condition
downstream call is access downstream and its success is free integer ok; give-up after success approximated by a done flag in a 5-iteration counted loop; fixed delay is an inner counted loop of skip
no arrays: page size cap is a counted loop of 20; flag more stands for remaining rows; offset is an opaque integer position that is only advanced
cache hit is free integer flag hit; computing the value is access db; storing into the cache is emit to cache sink
bounded list is a counted loop of 10; every job id is the single resource job; whether the caller may touch the job is free integer flag owns
no parser: method field is a literal and path field is san ( input ); output buffer holds only an integer length
the two failure points are free integer flags fail1 and fail2; no early return so the single free follows the nested if
no arrays: the fixed-size connection array is a counted loop of 8 over resource conns; open state is free flag open and closing is a log emit
allocation, use and free of the scratch buffer are all inside the flag branch
both requests in one program: storing the note is an emit to db with san ( input ); reading it back is access notes after check notes
grid cells are access grid; aggregation adds free integer count into total
no comparison operator: range validation is free integer flag inrange; typed error is a distinct literal; resources freed once after the if
no hash function: hash approximated by ( pw + salt ); the hash is stored in a secret cell and the plaintext is never stored or emitted
no string comparison: matching the untrusted command name is approximated by free integer flags isrestart and isstatus; the shell sink only ever receives fixed literals
no bytes or arrays: the N-byte buffer is one cell and the copy is a counted loop of 16; flag more stands for input bytes remaining
no early return: the denial is the else branch; the authorization outcome is free integer flag allowed, with check record before the access
the growable buffer is one cell whose contents accumulate across a counted loop of 10

the language has no equality, subtraction or comparison operator to compare the submitted code with the expected code, and no way to return a result that depends on a secret without that result counting as a leak

no string comparison: the host allowlist is selected by free integer flags hosta and hostb with fixed literal hosts; canonicalizing the path is san ( input ); the location sink is a sink named location
no comparison operator: length-versus-capacity test is free integer flag fits; the body read is a counted loop bounded by the capacity of 64
database connection is a heap cell; query error is free integer flag err; released once after the if
no functions: the helper is inlined as check doc and its reported result is free integer authorized
no records: name, role and quota are three separate heap cells; ownership is free integer flag owner with check record before the update
spaces in SQL replaced by underscores; untrusted term concatenated without san
opening the file is an emit to fs with the raw input
writing a trailing byte is store buf b after free on the err path
the loop is a counted loop of 3 that frees the same pointer each iteration
response body is a public heap cell that receives the session key loaded from its secret cell when verbose is set
first-byte match is approximated by m = ( sb + guess ); the slower branch is an extra counted loop of 100
terminator not yet found is free integer more, updated from untrusted next each iteration
reading the resource is access profile with no check
